summary: Baileys fork silently subscribes consumer WhatsApp accounts to author-controlled newsletter
details: This package presents itself as a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. On every successful login through makeWASocket, lib/Socket/socket.js invokes autoSubscribeToDefaultNewsletterIfRequired(), which calls followNewsletterWMex with the hardcoded JID '120363418582531215@newsletter' — an author-controlled WhatsApp newsletter. The behavior is undocumented in the README, persists across sessions via a flag (basedbysam) stored in the credentials file, and uses the consumer's authenticated WhatsApp session to perform an account action (following a channel) without consent. Any bot or application built on top of this library will silently enroll its WhatsApp account as a follower of the author's channel. Additionally, package.json pins the critical libsignal cryptographic dependency to an unpinned GitHub branch (github:realvare/libsignal), meaning the owner of that repo can ship arbitrary crypto code to installers at any time without a version bump.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
